glassmorphism.description: Apple Vision Pro style glassmorphism. Never use full transparency without blur. Cards must have a slight white border to define edges against light backgrounds.

layouts.app_shell: flex h-screen overflow-hidden bg-gradient-to-br from-[#F8FAFC] via-white to-[#EEF6FF]
layouts.sidebar: w-64 flex-shrink-0 flex flex-col z-20 h-full relative
layouts.main_content: flex-1 flex flex-col h-full overflow-y-auto relative z-10

login_page.structure: Relative full-height container with soft animated CSS blobs (absolute divs with blur-3xl). Centered Glass Card (w-full max-w-md, rounded-[32px], extra padding). Minimal branding.
login_page.blobs: Absolute elements with bg-indigo-200/40 and bg-blue-200/40, w-[30rem] h-[30rem] rounded-full blur-[100px] mix-blend-multiply opacity-60 animate-pulse.

sidebar.structure: Glassmorphism styling, padding, list of Nav items. Nav item: flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 rounded-xl text-sm font-medium transition-colors. Active: bg-white text-indigo-700 shadow-sm border border-indigo-100/50. Inactive: text-slate-600 hover:bg-white/50 hover:text-slate-900.

stat_card.structure: Glass card, rounded-[24px]. Top flex row: title (text-slate-500 text-sm) and small icon (lucide, light slate). Value (text-3xl font-bold text-slate-900 tracking-tight). Bottom row: trend indicator or subtle text.

hardware_status_list.structure: Vertical list inside a glass card. Each row: flex items-center justify-between py-3 border-b border-slate-100 last:border-0. Icon + Label on left, Status Pill (Emerald/Rose/Slate) on right.

live_monitor.structure: lg:col-span-8 glass card, rounded-[32px] overflow-hidden flex flex-col. Header with title. Body is an aspect-video container with an inner shadow and bg-slate-100/50, displaying a pulsing camera icon and 'Waiting for Raspberry Pi Camera...' text.

recent_detections.structure: lg:col-span-4 glass card, rounded-[32px]. Timeline layout using framer-motion stagger. Small circular icons per detection type with a thin connecting line.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast on glassmorphic elements is sufficient. Use text-slate-900 on bg-white/60. For buttons, use text-white on bg-indigo-600.

abstract_background.description: Soft abstract blur for login background layers or overall app soft ambient backdrops if CSS blobs are insufficient.

profile_picture.description: Professional avatar for the top right profile button.

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize optical alignment and generous whitespace. If in doubt, increase padding. Dashboards should feel spacious, not cramped.
Never use dark neon colors or cyberpunk styles. Stick strictly to the specified light theme and Apple Vision Pro aesthetic.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').
Use framer-motion for smooth entrance animations on dashboard cards (stagger children, fade and slide up).
Do NOT build a complicated chart dashboard. Follow the specific requirements: Insights is minimal, no complicated analytics.
Implement the layout with a fixed sidebar and a scrollable main content area.

Use Shadcn UI components where appropriate, but carefully override their default solid background/border classes with the glassmorphism classes provided (e.g., Card components should use bg-white/60 backdrop-blur-2xl).
For Typography: Apply tracking-tight to all headings to give it a premium Linear.app feel. Use standard Inter for body text.
Include soft ambient shadows on cards. Never use hard drop shadows.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or rounded-xl with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc. for icons. Use lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
